cohort: This guideline is intended for use by health professionals providing antepartum care in Canada for pregnancies with and without risk factors for adverse perinatal outcomes, based on a comprehensive review of randomized controlled trials.
finding: The guideline provides new recommendations for antepartum fetal surveillance methods to decrease the incidence of birth asphyxia while maintaining the lowest possible rate of obstetrical intervention.
mod_finding: The contraction stress test, together with clinical circumstances, will aid in decision making about timing and mode of delivery.
gest_age: Fetal movement counting (26-32 weeks), Uterine artery Doppler (17-22 weeks, 24-26 weeks), Double marker screen (at or before 18 weeks)
